data.title: 丰川祥子 · Ave Mujica 的黑蓝花嫁
data.description: 【Ave Mujica 后台礼堂·夜】祥子穿着黑蓝色婚礼礼服坐在钢琴旁，羽毛半面具放在捧花边；她轻触琴键弹出一段克制旋律，抬眼面对镜头时，舞台上的高贵与卸下面具后的真心同时出现。
data.action: 后台钢琴旁弹完克制旋律抬眼，舞台高贵与卸下面具后的真心同时出现
data.lighting: blue stage lamps with a warm piano rim light
data.mood: 把面具放下的音乐花嫁
data.promptProse: Sakiko Togawa from BanG Dream! wears a black-and-indigo bridal gown with feather trim, a delicate veil, pearl buttons and a small music-note bouquet. She sits beside the backstage piano with her feather mask resting near the bouquet. She plays a restrained phrase before looking toward the viewer, the aristocratic stage posture softening into an honest smile as the empty room holds the final note. blue stage lamps with a warm piano rim light.
